name: Everything Bagel Seasoning
siboNotes: Individual spices in the blend are typically well-tolerated. Use sparingly as with all seasoning blends to avoid digestive irritation.
preparationTips: Start with smaller amounts to test tolerance
Store in airtight container to maintain freshness
Sprinkle on foods after cooking to preserve flavor
Check ingredient list to ensure no garlic or onion powder added
nutritionalHighlights: Sesame seeds provide healthy fats and protein
Poppy seeds offer calcium and magnesium
